label: R1 · Your main 1
question: Which land should you play this turn — or none?
rationale: Nothing in hand costs one mana you can make this turn, so the tapped land costs nothing now: play Thriving Isle (choosing white) on turn 1. Then turn 2 is Island + Ant-Man's Air Force ({1}{U}) and turn 3 has white for Quake, Web Up or Spy Kit. Island first would leave Thriving Isle to enter tapped on turn 2 and waste the 2-drop. Skipping the land drop is a clear blunder.
